entities.name: Nexus of Fate
entities.description: Climactic event on Tarkir in which Sarkhan Vol altered the plane's fate by going into the past to save Ugin.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker who traveled into the past and encased Ugin in a hedron cocoon.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Spirit dragon, twin brother of Bolas, mortally wounded and then preserved by Sarkhan.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon who tracked and fought his twin brother Ugin on Tarkir.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: Sarkhan's old enemy who tracked him.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Planeswalker who awakened Ugin seeking counsel against the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Ugin's Nexus
entities.description: Ugin's resting place, where the time rift was unlocked.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: Plane where the event takes place.

entities.name: Khanfall
entities.description: Overthrow of the khans by the risen dragons.

entities.name: Dragonlords
entities.description: Rulers of Tarkir after the timeline changed.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Threat Sorin sought Ugin's counsel against.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas tracks Ugin to Tarkir and they fight a battle that mortally wounds Ugin.
events.quote: the two elder dragons fought a monumental battle that left Ugin mortally wounded

events.summary: Sarkhan, drawn by Ugin's whispers, goes to Ugin's Nexus with Narset and Zurgo following.
events.quote: found himself drawn to the spirit dragon's resting place

events.summary: Sarkhan unlocks a time rift, travels 1,280 years into the past and encases Ugin in a hedron cocoon.
events.quote: Sarkhan intervened by encasing the wounded dragon in a hedron cocoon

events.summary: Dragonstorms intensify, dragons multiply, the khans fall in the Khanfall and the dragonlords rise.
events.quote: The dragonlords rose to rule the plane

events.summary: Sorin Markov arrives and awakens Ugin from his cocoon, seeking counsel against the Eldrazi.
events.quote: Sorin Markov arrived and awoke still dormant Ugin from his cocoon

relations.quote: Nicol Bolas tracked his twin brother Ugin to Tarkir
led by his new-forged friend Narset
tracked by his old enemy Zurgo
